description: A column hierarchy manager for wide Svelte 5 grids. A side panel exposes the column tree: every group has a chevron and a checkbox, every leaf a checkbox. Collapsing a group replaces its children with one synthetic summary column, checkboxes hide or show a leaf or a whole subtree, and leaf chips can be dragged between siblings to reorder. The columns prop is a $derived of a small tree state, and the grid renders real nested group headers with one row per depth and proper colSpan.

faq.question: How do I define nested column headers?
faq.answer: Give a column definition a columns array of child definitions. The grid renders one header row per depth with the group header spanning its children, and groups can nest as deep as you need.

faq.question: How does collapsing a group into a summary column work?
faq.answer: The derived columns array swaps the group's children for one synthetic column with a cell snippet that shows the group's most important value. Expanding restores the children.

faq.question: Does changing the columns array reset the grid?
faq.answer: No. The grid swaps its column tree in place, so scroll position, sorting and selection survive each toggle in the panel.
